comment: The position of the Discount line among the cart and checkout totals, as a sort order number.
modal: A numeric sort order that sets where the Discount line appears in the totals block of the cart and checkout. Lower numbers appear higher. Can differ per website.

comment: The position of the Grand Total line among the cart and checkout totals, as a sort order number.
modal: A numeric sort order that sets where the Grand Total line appears in the totals block of the cart and checkout. Lower numbers appear higher. Can differ per website.

comment: The position of the Shipping line among the cart and checkout totals, as a sort order number.
modal: A numeric sort order that sets where the Shipping line appears in the totals block of the cart and checkout. Lower numbers appear higher. Can differ per website.

comment: The position of the Subtotal line among the cart and checkout totals, as a sort order number.
modal: A numeric sort order that sets where the Subtotal line appears in the totals block of the cart and checkout. Lower numbers appear higher. Can differ per website.

comment: The position of the Tax line among the cart and checkout totals, as a sort order number.
modal: A numeric sort order that sets where the Tax line appears in the totals block of the cart and checkout. Lower numbers appear higher. Can differ per website.

comment: Whether customers can reorder a previous order from their account.
modal: When Yes, the Reorder action is available in the customer account and order history, letting shoppers place a new order based on a past one. Can differ per store view.

comment: Whether a credit memo with a zero grand total can be created.
modal: When Yes, a credit memo can be issued even when its grand total comes to zero. Can differ per store view.

comment: The store address printed on invoices and packing slips.
modal: The address block shown in the header of printed invoices and packing slips. Can differ per website or store view.

comment: Whether a minimum order amount is required before checkout.
modal: When Yes, orders whose total is below the configured minimum amount cannot be placed. Can differ per website.

comment: Whether the minimum order amount is compared with tax included.
modal: Chooses whether the order total is checked against the minimum amount including tax or excluding it. Can differ per website.

comment: The message shown in the cart when the order is below the minimum amount.
modal: The error text displayed in the shopping cart when the order total is below the minimum order amount. Can differ per store view.

comment: Whether each address must meet the minimum order amount in multi-address checkout.
modal: When Yes, the minimum order amount is validated for each shipping address separately during multi-address checkout, rather than against the order as a whole. Can differ per website.

comment: How long, in minutes, a pending-payment order is kept before it is cancelled.
modal: The lifetime in minutes for orders awaiting payment; a scheduled job cancels orders older than this. Can differ per website.

comment: Whether sales emails are queued and sent in the background rather than immediately.
modal: When Enabled, sales emails are sent asynchronously through the message queue and cron instead of at the moment of the action. Options are Enable and Disable.

comment: Whether the new order confirmation email is sent.
modal: When Yes, a confirmation email is sent to the customer when an order is placed. Can differ per store view.

comment: Which store email identity the new order confirmation is sent from.
modal: Selects the sender for order confirmation emails — one of the Store Email Addresses identities (General Contact, Sales Representative, Customer Support, Custom 1/2). Applies only when the order email is enabled. Can differ per store view.

comment: How copies of the order confirmation email are sent — as Bcc or as a separate email.
modal: Chooses whether copies of the order confirmation are sent as a **Bcc** on the customer's email or as a **Separate Email**. Applies only when the order email is enabled. Can differ per store view.

comment: Whether an email is sent when a comment is added to an order.
modal: When Yes, the customer is emailed when a comment is added to their order. Can differ per store view.

comment: Which store email identity the order comment email is sent from.
modal: Selects the sender for order comment emails — one of the Store Email Addresses identities (General Contact, Sales Representative, Customer Support, Custom 1/2). Applies only when the order comment email is enabled. Can differ per store view.

comment: How copies of the order comment email are sent — as Bcc or as a separate email.
modal: Chooses whether copies of the order comment email are sent as a **Bcc** on the customer's email or as a **Separate Email**. Applies only when the order comment email is enabled. Can differ per store view.

comment: Whether the invoice email is sent.
modal: When Yes, an email is sent to the customer when an invoice is created for their order. Can differ per store view.

comment: Which store email identity the invoice email is sent from.

comment: Whether the order ID is shown in the header of printed invoices.
modal: When Yes, the order ID is printed in the header of the invoice PDF. Can differ per store view.

comment: Whether the order ID is shown in the header of printed shipments.
modal: When Yes, the order ID is printed in the header of the shipment (packing slip) PDF. Can differ per store view.

comment: Whether the order ID is shown in the header of printed credit memos.
modal: When Yes, the order ID is printed in the header of the credit memo PDF. Can differ per store view.

comment: Whether the customer order status RSS feed is available.
modal: When Enabled, customers can subscribe to an RSS feed that reports their order status changes. Options are Enable and Disable. Can differ per store view.

comment: Whether sales grid data is re-indexed asynchronously in the background.
modal: When Enabled, updates to the order, invoice, shipment and credit memo grids are indexed asynchronously by cron rather than on each save, which improves save performance on busy stores. Options are Enable and Disable.
